capabilities: Recognize hand-drawn digits, operators, parentheses and variables with a CNN model
Parse drawn mathematical expressions in real time
Solve and simplify equations when an equals sign is drawn
extras: Model files are downloaded from Hugging Face at runtime rather than bundled; the directory listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to compute equations by hand-drawing them; solving drawn expressions normally requires separate math or calculator tools.

relations.evidence: Excalidraw Extras Plugin for latex text

summary: Handwriting-recognition calculator that solves math equations drawn in Excalidraw and shows the result on canvas as LaTeX.
